### 1. Problem Statement
*Describe the failure mode or limitation in current LLM judges that this idea aims to solve.*

### 2. Proposed Mechanism / Solution
*What is the game-theoretic mechanism or multi-agent configuration you are proposing? Describe players, strategies, and payoffs.*

### 3. Mathematical Feasibility
*Are there existing proper scoring rules, bargaining solutions, or debate formats we can leverage? Define any relevant equations.*

### 4. Empirical Evaluation Plan
*Which datasets (MT-Bench, AlpacaEval, RewardBench) will be used to benchmark the results, and what is the expected improvement?*

### 5. Related Work & Key Gaps
*List 2-3 key papers this builds on and describe why this idea is novel compared to them.*
